commits.notes: Frozen open-source reference workflow specification, synthetic fixtures, and self-contained validator.
Locked reproducible open-source compilers, runtimes, providers and self-contained resource validator.
Unified local Go engine setup, loopback supervisor, clean shutdown, and smoke tests verified.
Typed versioned domain inputs and results v1, Go engine contract validation, limits and cancellation, and C04 fixtures verified.
ADR-0003 local single-writer storage port, atomic manifest publication, stable operation IDs, idempotency replay, and interrupted/disk-full recovery verified.
Engine clean-checkout verification, runtime.yml CI workflow, ENGINE_TESTS documentation, and positive/negative security invariant suites verified.
Domain model for route and resource classes implemented in internal/policy/model.go; F01 public routes explicit and unspecified routes default-private verified.

Bounded local OPA policy bundle evaluator implemented in internal/policy/opa.go; F02 invalid policy and deadline deny/error semantics, tampered byte detection, and monotonic authority retention verified.
Offline decision fixture simulator implemented in internal/policy/simulator.go and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F03 changed allow/deny decisions with reasons and policy digest verified.
Deterministic signed policy bundle builder implemented in internal/bundles/build.go and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F04 bundle records issuer, digest, revision and validity period verified.

Bundle trust and freshness verification implemented in internal/bundles/verify.go and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F05 unsigned, tampered, expired, or replayed bundles rejected before activation verified.

Atomic bundle activation and rollback implemented in internal/bundles/activate.go and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F06 active bundle switches atomically and failed activation retains prior bundle verified.
OIDC callback validation implemented in internal/auth/oidc.go and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F07 wrong issuer, wrong audience, replayed nonce, and expired tokens rejected verified.

Revocable server-side session persistence implemented in internal/auth/session.go and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F08 session fingerprints, redacted server-held credentials, and cookie rotation against fixation verified.

Bounded 30-second stale authorization window enforcer implemented in internal/auth/revoke.go and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F09 revoked session stops within configured 30-second bound under target workload verified.
Gateway identity normalization implemented in internal/gateway/identity.go and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F10 client identity headers stripped before trusted values are constructed verified.

Allowlisted single upstream proxy and origin isolation implemented in internal/gateway/proxy.go and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F11 arbitrary upstream URLs cannot be selected and origin is reachable only by gateway verified.

Policy obligation enforcement and fail-closed handling implemented in internal/gateway/obligations.go, internal/gateway/proxy.go, and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F12 unknown mandatory obligation denies rather than being ignored verified.

Per-resource outage behavior and fail-closed handling implemented in internal/gateway/failure.go, internal/gateway/proxy.go, and cmd/policyhelix/main.go; F13 decision loss denies sensitive routes and public route bypass remains intentional and testable verified.
Decision audit logging and credential redaction implemented in internal/audit/decision.go; F14 decision includes subject pseudonym, policy and outcome without bearer token or cookie verified.
Policy simulator and decision diff UI implemented in apps/web/src/pages/Simulator.tsx; F15 UI displays policy revision and explains changed decision using fixture context verified.
Gateway health and session revoke dashboard implemented in apps/web/src/pages/Gateway.tsx; F16 operator sees stale policy, IdP outage and revocation result without exposing tokens verified.

Candidate policy shadow execution and auditable divergence tracking implemented in internal/rollout/shadow.go and tests/shadow_test.go; F17 shadow decision never changes enforced result and divergence is auditable verified.

Bounded policy decision cache keys, expiry TTL, and revocation invalidation implemented in internal/policy/cache.go and tests/cache_test.go; F18 subject, action, context, and revision key binding and revocation verified.

Operator-controlled trust key rotation without rollback gap and removed-key rejection implemented in internal/bundles/keys.go and tests/key_rotation_test.go; F19 new trust set is operator-controlled and removed key cannot activate an old signed bundle verified.

End-to-end enforcement matrix verification implemented in internal/gateway/enforcement.go, tests/enforcement_matrix_test.go and docs/evidence/enforcement-template.md; F20 direct origin, forged header, revoked session, expired bundle and policy outage enforcement verified.

Negative UAT, XSS/import prototype-pollution guards, and object/provider authorization (IDOR) boundary suite implemented in internal/gateway/security.go, tests/security_suite_test.go, tests/browser/security.spec.ts, tests/release/security-matrix.md and docs/security/THREAT_MODEL.md; Requirement N27 verified.

Bounded target and overload workload evaluation engine implemented in internal/gateway/benchmark.go; scripts/benchmark-local.mjs, tests/scenarios/target-workload.json, tests/workload_test.go, tests/browser/benchmark.spec.ts, and docs/evidence/performance.json; latency SLO p95 <= 200ms, payload limit 64 KiB, saturation, cancellation, and restart recovery verified; Requirement N28 verified.

Engine readiness and redacted diagnostics implemented in internal/gateway/diagnostics.go; storage and required provider (OPA, Keycloak, Upstream) outage visibility and fail-closed 503 errors; ring-buffered telemetry bounded at 100 entries and 4KB message limit; automatic Bearer/JWT/cookie/sentinel credential scrubbing; /readyz and /api/v1/runtime/readiness deep inspection; ops/diagnostics.md, tests/web/engine-readiness.test.mjs, and tests/readiness_test.go verified; Requirement N29 verified.

Clean-clone local reference workflow implemented in internal/reference/reference.go and internal/gateway/live.go; six executed stages, signed Ed25519 bundle activation, owned loopback upstream protection, spoofed-header/direct-origin rejection, bounded revocation, outage/expired-bundle fail-closed, seven required negative fixtures, durable restart/restore and browser acceptance verified through scripts/clone-smoke.mjs and tests/browser/clone-to-value.spec.ts; Requirement N30 verified.

Complete reproducible open-source release packaging implemented in scripts/package.sh and scripts/package-source.mjs; Go engine binary, web UI assets, offline Rego rules, reproducible source archive with build recipes, CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM, third-party notices, cryptographic checksums (SHA256SUMS.txt), provenance metadata (release.json), staged-byte atomic crash recovery and fail-closed security verified through tests/package_release_test.go and tests/web/packaging.test.mjs; Requirement N31 verified.

Network boundaries, local launch hardening and optional private hosting implemented and verified; zero public domain dependency proven; loopback authorities (localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1]) enforced with external Host header rejection (DNS-rebinding defense); cross-origin requests rejected with invalid_origin; Cache-Control: no-store strictly enforced on all dynamic routes while assets remain immutable; optional private ingress documented in infra/deployment.md and docs/evidence/domain.json; verified via tests/web/network-boundaries.test.mjs; Requirement N32 verified.

UX, keyboard navigation, mobile 360px and desktop 1440px viewports, accessible table equivalent representation, failure resilience (empty, invalid, interrupted, provider-outage), N-1 export compatibility, and observed platform advertising implemented and verified; full reference workflow passes at 1440px desktop; zero horizontal overflow verified at 360px mobile; sequential keyboard navigation verified; accessible table equivalent view toggle verified; network interruption abort and 422 failure recovery verified; N-1 v1 report import backward compatibility verified; tampered export rejected fail-closed; observed platform (Linux x86_64) advertised with unverified platform disclaimer; verified via tests/browser/full-workflow-accessibility.spec.ts and tests/c33_ux_fixtures_test.go; Requirement N33 verified.

Complete installation, usage, contribution, and support guides implemented; public user guide (docs/release/USER_GUIDE.md), confirmed private vulnerability reporting route in SECURITY.md (GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting and security@policyhelix.org with 48h SLA), independent offline source build recipes, upstream license inventory, local data layout (.local-data/), operational limits (<=200ms decision deadline, 2 vCPU/4GB RAM/10GB disk), loopback-only privacy, crash recovery and forward repair, and community support channels documented; README.md, OPEN_SOURCE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/engineering/CLONE_TO_RUN.md updated; verified via tests/fixtures/policyhelix/C34/, tests/c34_oss_guides_test.go, and tests/web/oss-guides.test.mjs; Requirement N34 verified.
